description: One swap offer by offer_id with its fill and cancel events. Use it after list_swap_offers to inspect a single offer. money_moved: true when filled, null when a fill was submitted but is not final (POAScan can't see external-chain payments; the buyer may have paid, so never read null as no payment), false only when no fill tx exists. taker_credit (poa minus fee_poa) on a final fill, refund_txid on a cancel, receipt_state signed when a finalized fill carries the seller's receipt; null when not applicable. An expired offer has refund_txid null until the maker cancels; pre-fill receipts are not public.
name: get_swap_offer
title: Swap offer
